products.name: Ornament Christmas tree
products.description:
Handmade wooden Christmas tree with a hanging ornament. A simple, eye-catching holiday piece made to be enjoyed for many seasons.

Available in three classic colors:
* Red
* Green
* White

Looks great on a mantel, tabletop, shelf, or as part of a holiday centerpiece.

🎄 Add a little handmade Christmas magic to your home.
